title: Well-plate cell viability assay for cells cultured in 3D broccoli-based scaffolds
author: Kristopher E Kubow

steps.title: Seed fibroblasts onto scaffolds
steps.instruction: Seed fibroblasts onto 3.5 mm scaffolds in a 96-well plate, ensuring at least three replicates per experimental condition.

substeps.instruction: Seed cells at the desired density (e.g., 15,000 cells per 3.5 mm scaffold for MEFs).
Ensure seeding density is sufficient for detection (limit of detection is approximately 500 cells).

steps.title: Transfer scaffolds to new wells
steps.instruction: Move the scaffolds to new wells to ensure only cells attached to the scaffolds are measured, removing cells attached to the original well surface.

substeps.instruction: Use forceps to carefully transfer scaffolds to new wells.
Add 100 µL culture medium to each well.

steps.title: Prepare blank wells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL culture medium to three empty wells to serve as blanks.

steps.title: Add MTT reagent
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL MTT reagent to each well, including the blanks.

steps.title: Incubate with MTT
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate in the cell culture incubator for 4 hours.

substeps.instruction: Verify purple precipitates are visible under an inverted microscope.
Note: Some cell types may require incubation up to 24 h.

steps.title: Add solubilization buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL solubilization buffer to each well, including the blanks.

steps.title: Incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate in the cell culture incubator overnight.

steps.title: Remove scaffolds
steps.instruction: Remove the scaffolds to prevent interference with absorbance measurements.

substeps.instruction: Either use forceps to remove and discard the scaffolds, or pipette 200 µL volume from each well into new wells.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of each well using a plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Set the primary wavelength to 570 nm.
Use a reference wavelength >650 nm if required.
